WITH txn_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date as visit_date,
    visitId,
    visitStartTime,
    device.deviceCategory as deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
),
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_txn AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(visitStartTime) as first_txn_time
  FROM txn_sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_txn_details AS (
  SELECT 
    v.fullVisitorId,
    v.visit_date as first_txn_date,
    v.deviceCategory
  FROM txn_sessions v
  INNER JOIN first_txn ft ON v.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId AND v.visitStartTime = ft.first_txn_time
)
SELECT 
  ft.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ftd.first_txn_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ftd.first_txn_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  ftd.deviceCategory
FROM first_txn ft
JOIN first_visit fv ON ft.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
JOIN first_txn_details ftd ON ft.fullVisitorId = ftd.fullVisitorId
ORDER BY days_elapsed DESC

WITH daily_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    date AS day_date,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS daily_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY day_date
),
weekly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS weekly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY week_start
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' AS traffic_source,
  (SELECT MAX(daily_revenue_millions) FROM daily_revenue) AS max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(weekly_revenue_millions) FROM weekly_revenue) AS max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) FROM monthly_revenue) AS max_monthly_product_revenue_millions

WITH product_revenue_check AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s, UNNEST(s.hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId
),
session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.date,
    s.totals.pageviews,
    s.totals.transactions,
    COALESCE(pr.has_product_revenue, 0) as has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
  LEFT JOIN product_revenue_check pr ON s.fullVisitorId = pr.fullVisitorId
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    pageviews,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue = 1 THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND has_product_revenue = 0 THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_data
)
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
  session_type,
  AVG(pageviews) as avg_pageviews
FROM classified
WHERE session_type IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS t,
UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
UNNEST(h.product) AS p,
youtube_buyers yb
WHERE t.fullVisitorId = yb.fullVisitorId
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    d.date,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) as z_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(d.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_counts d
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT date, z_score, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn = 2

WITH filtered_sessions AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, hits
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND LOWER(trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
),
all_page_hits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, 
         h.hitNumber, h.time, h.page.pagePath
  FROM filtered_sessions, UNNEST(hits) h
  WHERE h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_with_next AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, time as homeTime, pagePath as homePage,
         LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) as nextTime,
         LEAD(pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) as nextPage
  FROM all_page_hits
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT nextPage, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE nextPage IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nextPage
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT SAFE_CAST(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(nextTime - homeTime), 1000)) AS INT64) as max_time_sec
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE nextPage IS NOT NULL AND homePage = '/home'
)
SELECT np.nextPage as most_common_next_page, mt.max_time_sec
FROM next_page_counts np, max_time mt

SELECT 
  traffic_source,
  MAX(monthly_rev) as highest_monthly_rev,
  MIN(monthly_rev) as lowest_monthly_rev,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(monthly_rev) - MIN(monthly_rev), 1000000), 2) as diff_millions
FROM (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source as traffic_source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source, month
)
WHERE traffic_source = '(direct)'
GROUP BY traffic_source

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) = 'youtube men's vintage henley'
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
),
customer_purchases_all_time AS (
  SELECT qc.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM qualifying_customers qc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
    ON qc.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE LOWER(p.v2ProductName) != 'youtube men's vintage henley'
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY qc.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM customer_purchases_all_time
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH 
-- Users with positive engagement time in 7-day period (Jan 1-7, 2021)
users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
),
-- Users with positive engagement time in 2-day period (Jan 6-7, 2021)
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM users_2day u2 WHERE u2.user_pseudo_id = u7.user_pseudo_id
)

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) as prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) IN (3, 4)
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) as date_mmdd,
  new_confirmed,
  prev_new_confirmed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) as growth_rate
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC

WITH top_routes AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_name,
    end_station_name,
    ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
    ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
    ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
    ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_lon, start_lat, end_lon, end_lat
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
taxi_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as pickup_lon,
    ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as pickup_lat,
    ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as dropoff_lon,
    ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as dropoff_lat,
    AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration,
    COUNT(*) as taxi_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
  GROUP BY pickup_lon, pickup_lat, dropoff_lon, dropoff_lat
)
SELECT 
  tr.start_station_name,
  tr.end_station_name,
  tr.trip_count,
  tr.avg_bike_duration,
  ts.avg_taxi_duration
FROM top_routes tr
INNER JOIN taxi_stats ts 
  ON tr.start_lon = ts.pickup_lon 
  AND tr.start_lat = ts.pickup_lat
  AND tr.end_lon = ts.dropoff_lon
  AND tr.end_lat = ts.dropoff_lat
WHERE tr.avg_bike_duration < ts.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY tr.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    CAST(ROUND(trip_seconds / 60.0, 0) AS INT64) as trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) as quantile_group
  FROM trips
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  CAST(MIN(trip_minutes) AS INT64) as min_duration_minutes,
  CAST(MAX(trip_minutes) AS INT64) as max_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  AVG(fare) as avg_fare
FROM grouped
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

SELECT 
  acs.geo_id AS census_tract,
  AVG(f.transaction_amt) AS avg_donation,
  acs.median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` acs
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` cw
  ON acs.geo_id = cw.census_tract_geoid
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` f
  ON SUBSTRING(f.zip_code, 1, 5) = cw.zip_code AND f.state = 'NY'
WHERE acs.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
GROUP BY acs.geo_id, acs.median_income
ORDER BY acs.geo_id

WITH condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        p.evaluation_group,
        p.evaluation_group_description,
        p.evaluation_type,
        p.evaluation_description,
        p.state_code,
        c.condition_status_code,
        SUM(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot) as total_subplot_acres,
        SUM(COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0)) as total_macroplot_acres
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
        ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number 
        AND c.state_code = p.state_code
        AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
    WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        evaluation_type,
        evaluation_description,
        state_code,
        condition_status_code,
        total_macroplot_acres,
        total_subplot_acres,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
    FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
    CAST(evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    evaluation_description,
    CAST(state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    condition_status_code,
    ROUND(total_macroplot_acres, 2) as macroplot_acres,
    ROUND(total_subplot_acres, 2) as subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    a.country_name,
    SUM(a.population) AS total_pop_under_20,
    m.midyear_population,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(a.population), m.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` m
    ON a.country_code = m.country_code AND a.year = m.year
WHERE a.year = 2020 AND a.age BETWEEN 0 AND 19
GROUP BY a.country_name, m.midyear_population
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT country_name, cumulative_confirmed, cumulative_recovered,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) AS recovery_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE date = DATE('2020-05-10')
  AND aggregation_level = 0
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH rochester_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(year || '-' || mo || '-' || da AS DATE) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290'
    AND year = '2019'
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
converted AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    (temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0 AS temp_c,
    prcp_in * 2.54 AS prcp_cm,
    wdsp_knots * 0.514444 AS wdsp_ms
  FROM rochester_data
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    ROUND(temp_c, 1) AS temp,
    ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) AS precipitation,
    ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) AS wind_speed,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prec_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wind_ma8
  FROM converted
)
SELECT
  date,
  temp,
  precipitation,
  wind_speed,
  temp_ma8,
  prec_ma8,
  wind_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag8_diff
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

WITH storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    usa_latitude,
    usa_longitude,
    iso_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND name = 'TEDDY'
)
SELECT usa_latitude
FROM storm_tracks
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT id, name
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
WHERE (6371 * ACOS(
  COS(41.8319 * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS((longitude + 87.6847) * 3.14159265358979 / 180) +
  SIN(41.8319 * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * SIN(latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180)
)) <= 50
ORDER BY id

SELECT 
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    2 * 6371000 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((s_end.latitude - s_start.latitude) * 3.141592653589793 / 180 / 2), 2) +
        COS(s_start.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS(s_end.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) *
        POWER(SIN((s_end.longitude - s_start.longitude) * 3.141592653589793 / 180 / 2), 2)
      )
    )
  ) as total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s_start
  ON t.start_station_id = s_start.station_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s_end
  ON t.end_station_id = s_end.station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC
LIMIT 10

-- but the question only asks for station name/identifier and proportion.

-- Let me submit the result
SELECT 
  sn.start_station_name as station_name,
  t10.proportion
FROM (
  WITH same_station_trips AS (
    SELECT 
      start_station_id,
      starttime,
      bikeid
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
  ),
  bucketed AS (
    SELECT 
      start_station_id,
      starttime,
      bikeid,
      SAFE_CAST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime) / 2 AS INT64) as minute_bucket,
      EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) as hour_bucket,
      EXTRACT(DATE FROM starttime) as trip_date
    FROM same_station_trips
  ),
  window_counts AS (
    SELECT 
      start_station_id,
      trip_date,
      hour_bucket,
      minute_bucket,
      COUNT(*) as trip_count
    FROM bucketed
    GROUP BY start_station_id, trip_date, hour_bucket, minute_bucket
  ),
  group_windows AS (
    SELECT start_station_id, trip_date, hour_bucket, minute_bucket
    FROM window_counts
    WHERE trip_count > 1
  ),
  group_trips AS (
    SELECT b.start_station_id
    FROM bucketed b
    JOIN group_windows g
      ON b.start_station_id = g.start_station_id
      AND b.trip_date = g.trip_date
      AND b.hour_bucket = g.hour_bucket
      AND b.minute_bucket = g.minute_bucket
  ),
  group_trip_counts AS (
    SELECT start_station_id, COUNT(*) as group_trip_count
    FROM group_trips
    GROUP BY start_station_id
  ),
  total_end_counts AS (
    SELECT 
      end_station_id,
      COUNT(*) as total_end_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id
  ),
  top10 AS (
    SELECT 
      g.start_station_id,
      g.group_trip_count,
      t.total_end_count,
      SAFE_DIVIDE(g.group_trip_count, t.total_end_count) as proportion
    FROM group_trip_counts g
    JOIN total_end_counts t ON g.start_station_id = t.end_station_id
    ORDER BY proportion DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
  SELECT * FROM top10
) t10
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT start_station_id, start_station_name, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY start_station_id, start_station_name
  )
) sn ON t10.start_station_id = sn.start_station_id AND sn.rn = 1

WITH users_2021 AS (
  SELECT id AS user_id, creation_date AS signup_date, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM creation_date) AS signup_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
user_first_question AS (
  SELECT 
    q.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    MIN(q.creation_date) AS first_question_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN users_2021 u ON q.owner_user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE q.creation_date >= u.signup_date
    AND q.creation_date < TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.signup_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY q.owner_user_id
),
user_first_answer_after_question AS (
  SELECT 
    a.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    MIN(a.creation_date) AS first_answer_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
  JOIN user_first_question qf ON a.owner_user_id = qf.user_id
  WHERE a.creation_date > qf.first_question_date
    AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(qf.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY a.owner_user_id
),
monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    u.signup_month, 
    COUNT(*) AS total_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT qf.user_id) AS users_asked,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fa.user_id) AS users_answered
  FROM users_2021 u
  LEFT JOIN user_first_question qf ON u.user_id = qf.user_id
  LEFT JOIN user_first_answer_after_question fa ON qf.user_id = fa.user_id
  GROUP BY u.signup_month
)
SELECT 
  signup_month AS month,
  total_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(users_asked * 100.0, total_users) AS pct_asked,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(users_answered * 100.0, users_asked) AS pct_answered
FROM monthly_stats
ORDER BY signup_month

WITH temp_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
    AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY year, mo, da
),
complaint_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(created_date AS DATE) as date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2017
  GROUP BY date, complaint_type
),
complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) as total_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2017
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000
),
joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t.date,
    t.avg_temp,
    d.complaint_type,
    d.daily_count,
    SUM(d.daily_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.date) as total_daily_complaints
  FROM temp_data t
  JOIN complaint_counts d ON t.date = d.date
  WHERE d.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM complaint_totals)
),
corr_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(avg_temp) as sum_temp,
    SUM(daily_count) as sum_count,
    SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) as sum_temp_sq,
    SUM(daily_count * daily_count) as sum_count_sq,
    SUM(avg_temp * daily_count) as sum_temp_count,
    SUM(avg_temp * (daily_count * 1.0 / total_daily_complaints)) as sum_temp_pct,
    SUM(daily_count * 1.0 / total_daily_complaints) as sum_pct,
    SUM(POWER(daily_count * 1.0 / total_daily_complaints, 2)) as sum_pct_sq
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
corr_results AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    n as num_days,
    sum_count as total_complaints,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (n * sum_temp_count - sum_temp * sum_count),
      SQRT((n * sum_temp_sq - sum_temp * sum_temp) * (n * sum_count_sq - sum_count * sum_count))
    ), 4) as corr_temp_count,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (n * sum_temp_pct - sum_temp * sum_pct),
      SQRT((n * sum_temp_sq - sum_temp * sum_temp) * (n * sum_pct_sq - sum_pct * sum_pct))
    ), 4) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM corr_calc
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  num_days as total_days_with_valid_temp,
  total_complaints,
  corr_temp_count,
  corr_temp_pct
FROM corr_results
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY ABS(corr_temp_count) DESC

WITH wind AS (
  SELECT 
    PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as date,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn = '744860'
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
    AND year BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
),
complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT date, SUM(daily_count) as total_count
  FROM complaints
  GROUP BY date
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT 
    c.date,
    c.complaint_type,
    c.daily_count,
    c.daily_count * 1.0 / d.total_count as proportion
  FROM complaints c
  JOIN daily_totals d ON c.date = d.date
),
total_complaints AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(daily_count) as total_requests
  FROM complaints
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.complaint_type,
    tc.total_requests,
    CORR(dp.proportion, w.wind_speed) as pearson_corr
  FROM daily_proportions dp
  JOIN wind w ON dp.date = w.date
  JOIN total_complaints tc ON dp.complaint_type = tc.complaint_type
  GROUP BY dp.complaint_type, tc.total_requests
  HAVING tc.total_requests > 3000
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_requests,
  ROUND(pearson_corr, 4) as correlation,
  pearson_corr
FROM correlations
WHERE pearson_corr = (SELECT MAX(pearson_corr) FROM correlations)
   OR pearson_corr = (SELECT MIN(pearson_corr) FROM correlations)

WITH 
-- Count non-dead trees per species in 1995
count_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) as non_dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE UPPER(spc_latin) NOT IN ('PLANTING SITE', 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES', 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES', 'UNKNOWN STUMP', 'STUMP', 'PINUS SPECIES')
    AND UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`)
    AND status != 'Dead'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Count alive trees per species in 2015
count_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) as alive_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
    AND UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`)
    AND status = 'Alive'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Combine and compute difference
species_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(c1.spc_latin_upper, c2.spc_latin_upper) as spc_latin_upper,
    COALESCE(c1.non_dead_count, 0) as count_1995,
    COALESCE(c2.alive_count, 0) as count_2015,
    COALESCE(c1.non_dead_count, 0) - COALESCE(c2.alive_count, 0) as diff
  FROM count_1995 c1
  FULL OUTER JOIN count_2015 c2 ON c1.spc_latin_upper = c2.spc_latin_upper
)
SELECT 
  ts.fall_color,
  SUM(sd.diff) as total_change
FROM species_diff sd
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = sd.spc_latin_upper
GROUP BY ts.fall_color
ORDER BY total_change DESC

WITH y1995 AS (
  SELECT

    spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good','Excellent','Poor','Fair','Critical','Shaft') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
),
y1995_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    latin_name,
    spc_common,
    SUM(total_1995) AS total_1995,
    SUM(alive_1995) AS alive_1995,
    SUM(dead_1995) AS dead_1995
  FROM y1995
  GROUP BY latin_name, spc_common
),
y1995_final AS (
  SELECT 
    latin_name,
    spc_common,
    total_1995,
    alive_1995,
    dead_1995
  FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin_name ORDER BY total_1995 DESC) AS rn
    FROM y1995_agg
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
y2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
)
SELECT 
  y1.latin_name,
  y2.spc_common AS common_name,
  y1.total_1995,
  y2.total_2015,
  y1.alive_1995,
  y2.alive_2015,
  y1.dead_1995,
  y2.dead_2015,
  y2.total_2015 - y1.total_1995 AS growth_total,
  y2.alive_2015 - y1.alive_1995 AS growth_alive,
  y2.dead_2015 - y1.dead_1995 AS growth_dead
FROM y1995_final y1
INNER JOIN y2015 y2 ON y1.latin_name = y2.latin_name
ORDER BY growth_total DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_asian) AS bls_avg_asian,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) AS bls_avg_black,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) AS bls_avg_hispanic,
    AVG(percent_white) AS bls_avg_white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18` 
  WHERE year = 2021 
    AND (subsector IN ('Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals', 'Software publishers', 'Data processing, hosting, and related services')

),
google_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    race_asian AS google_asian,
    race_black AS google_black,

    race_white AS google_white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`

),
race_diffs AS (

WITH berkeley_station_ids AS (

),
berkeley_trips AS (

    AND t.end_station_id IN UNNEST((SELECT ARRAY_AGG(station_id) FROM berkeley_station_ids))

)
SELECT MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(dist_meters, duration_sec)) AS max_speed_exact

WITH target_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` 
  WHERE state_code = 'WA' AND ST_INTERSECTS(zip_code_geom, ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833), 5 * 1609.34))
),
tracts AS (
  SELECT ct.geo_id, ct.total_pop, ct.income_per_capita, g.tract_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` ct
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` g ON ct.geo_id = g.geo_id
),
intersections AS (
  SELECT 
    t.zip_code,
    tr.total_pop,
    tr.income_per_capita,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, t.zip_code_geom)),
      ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom)
    ) as proportion
  FROM tracts tr
  JOIN target_zips t ON ST_INTERSECTS(tr.tract_geom, t.zip_code_geom)
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(total_pop * proportion), 0) as total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total_pop * proportion * income_per_capita), SUM(total_pop * proportion)), 1) as avg_individual_income
FROM intersections
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH morbidity AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as birth_year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS as county_fips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_Desc = 'None checked' THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE Year IN (DATE('2016-01-01'), DATE('2017-01-01'), DATE('2018-01-01'))
    AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
  GROUP BY birth_year, county_fips
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT m.birth_year, m.county_fips,
         m.no_morbidity_births, m.total_births,
         SAFE_DIVIDE(m.no_morbidity_births, m.total_births) as pct_no_morbidity,
         CASE WHEN m.birth_year = 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate
              WHEN m.birth_year = 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate
              WHEN m.birth_year = 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate
         END as poverty_rate
  FROM morbidity m
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c2015 ON m.county_fips = c2015.geo_id AND m.birth_year = 2016
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c2016 ON m.county_fips = c2016.geo_id AND m.birth_year = 2017
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c2017 ON m.county_fips = c2017.geo_id AND m.birth_year = 2018
  WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(m.no_morbidity_births, m.total_births) IS NOT NULL
    AND CASE WHEN m.birth_year = 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate
             WHEN m.birth_year = 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate
             WHEN m.birth_year = 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate
        END IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT birth_year,
       CORR(poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity) as pearson_correlation
FROM combined
GROUP BY birth_year

WITH body_type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    body_type,
    COUNT(*) as cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state_number, consecutive_number ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, body_type ASC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number, body_type
),
body_type_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_number, consecutive_number, body_type
  FROM body_type_counts
  WHERE rn = 1
),
vehicle_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    b.state_number,
    b.consecutive_number,
    b.body_type,
    AVG(ABS(
      SAFE_CAST(
        CASE 
          WHEN v.travel_speed NOT IN (997, 998, 999) AND v.speed_limit NOT IN (98, 99)
          THEN v.travel_speed - v.speed_limit
          ELSE NULL 
        END AS FLOAT64
      )
    )) AS avg_speed_diff
  FROM body_type_ranked b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016` v
    ON b.state_number = v.state_number AND b.consecutive_number = v.consecutive_number
  GROUP BY b.state_number, b.consecutive_number, b.body_type
),
person_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) AS distinct_persons
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016`
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) > 1
),
fatal_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatality_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016`
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
)
SELECT 
  a.state_number,
  v.body_type,
  a.number_of_drunk_drivers,
  a.day_of_week,
  a.hour_of_crash,
  CASE WHEN a.work_zone != 'None' AND a.work_zone IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS work_zone_binary,
  CASE 
    WHEN v.avg_speed_diff < 20 THEN 0
    WHEN v.avg_speed_diff < 40 THEN 1
    WHEN v.avg_speed_diff < 60 THEN 2
    WHEN v.avg_speed_diff < 80 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END AS speed_diff_level,
  CASE WHEN f.fatality_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS label
FROM person_counts p
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a
  ON p.state_number = a.state_number AND p.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
JOIN vehicle_agg v
  ON p.state_number = v.state_number AND p.consecutive_number = v.consecutive_number
JOIN fatal_counts f
  ON p.state_number = f.state_number AND p.consecutive_number = f.consecutive_number

WITH

-- Final query to get the state with highest timberland and highest forestland acreage
WITH latest_eval AS (
  SELECT peg.state_code, MAX(peg.evaluation_group_sequence_number) AS max_seq
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_evaluation_type` pet
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_evaluation_group` peg 
    ON pet.evaluation_group_sequence_number = peg.evaluation_group_sequence_number
  WHERE pet.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY peg.state_code
),
population_data AS (
  SELECT p.plot_sequence_number, p.state_code, p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_sequence_number,
         p.expansion_factor, p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN latest_eval le ON p.state_code = le.state_code AND p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = le.max_seq
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
condition_acres AS (
  SELECT pd.plot_sequence_number, pd.state_code, pd.evaluation_group, pd.evaluation_group_sequence_number,
         c.condition_status_code, c.reserved_status_code, c.site_productivity_class_code, c.proportion_basis,
         c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
         pd.expansion_factor,
         CASE 
           WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN pd.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
           WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN pd.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
           ELSE NULL
         END AS adj_factor
  FROM population_data pd
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON pd.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
),
state_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 AND reserved_status_code = 0 AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6 
             AND adj_factor > 0 
             THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adj_factor 
             ELSE 0 END) AS timberland_acres,
    SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 AND adj_factor > 0 
             THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adj_factor 
             ELSE 0 END) AS forestland_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
),
timberland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, timberland_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_acres
),
forestland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, forestland_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_acres
),
timberland_top AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, timberland_acres
  FROM timberland_ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
forestland_top AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, forestland_acres
  FROM forestland_ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  'timberland' AS category,
  tl.state_code,
  tl.evaluation_group,
  c.state_code_name,
  tl.timberland_acres AS total_acres
FROM timberland_top tl
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON tl.state_code = c.state_code
GROUP BY tl.state_code, tl.evaluation_group, c.state_code_name, tl.timberland_acres

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'forestland' AS category,
  fl.state_code,
  fl.evaluation_group,
  c.state_code_name,
  fl.forestland_acres AS total_acres
FROM forestland_top fl
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON fl.state_code = c.state_code
GROUP BY fl.state_code, fl.evaluation_group, c.state_code_name, fl.forestland_acres

WITH trips_with_region AS (

WITH filtered_data AS (

    SAFE_CAST(symptom_anosmia AS FLOAT64) AS anosmia_freq

  WHERE sub_region_1 = 'New York'

    AND symptom_anosmia != ''
),
yearly_avg AS (

WITH period1 AS (

),
period2 AS (

    AVG(SAFE_CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64)) as avg_anxiety_2020,
    AVG(SAFE_CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64)) as avg_depression_2020
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
  WHERE country_region = 'United States'

)
SELECT

distracted_accidents_2016 AS (
  SELECT d.state_number, COUNT(DISTINCT d.consecutive_number) as num_distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2016` d
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY d.state_number
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_number, state_name
  FROM (
    SELECT state_number, state_name FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT state_number, state_name FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016`
  )
),
state_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN za.state_name = 'Washington (state)' THEN 'Washington'
      WHEN za.state_name = 'Georgia (U.S. state)' THEN 'Georgia'
      ELSE za.state_name
    END as state_name,
    SUM(p.population) as total_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
    ON p.zipcode = za.zipcode
  WHERE za.state_name NOT IN (
      'Puerto Rico', 'Guam', 'United States Virgin Islands', 
      '"Washington, D.C."', 'District of Columbia'
    )
    AND p.gender IS NULL
    AND p.minimum_age IS NULL
    AND p.maximum_age IS NULL
    AND za.state_name NOT LIKE '%,%'
  GROUP BY 
    CASE 
      WHEN za.state_name = 'Washington (state)' THEN 'Washington'
      WHEN za.state_name = 'Georgia (U.S. state)' THEN 'Georgia'
      ELSE za.state_name
    END
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    sn.state_name,
    COALESCE(d2015.num_distracted_accidents, 0) as accidents_2015,
    COALESCE(d2016.num_distracted_accidents, 0) as accidents_2016,
    sp.total_population,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(d2015.num_distracted_accidents, 0) * 100000, sp.total_population), 2) as rate_2015_per_100k,

  LEFT JOIN distracted_accidents_2015 d2015 ON sn.state_number = d2015.state_number
  LEFT JOIN distracted_accidents_2016 d2016 ON sn.state_number = d2016.state_number
  JOIN state_pop sp ON sn.state_name = sp.state_name
),
top5_2015 AS (
  SELECT '2015' as year, state_name, accidents_2015, rate_2015_per_100k, total_population
  FROM combined WHERE accidents_2015 > 0
  ORDER BY rate_2015_per_100k DESC LIMIT 5

top5_2016 AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` 
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND season = '2020' AND sid = '2020233N14313'
),
consecutive_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    a.sid,
    a.name,
    a.iso_time AS time1,
    a.latitude AS lat1,
    a.longitude AS lon1,
    a.usa_wind AS wind1,
    b.iso_time AS time2,
    b.latitude AS lat2,
    b.longitude AS lon2,
    b.usa_wind AS wind2,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(a.longitude, a.latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(b.longitude, b.latitude)
    ) / 1000.0 AS dist_km
  FROM storm_tracks a
  JOIN storm_tracks b ON a.sid = b.sid AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
)

  time1,
  lat1,

-- which means we KEEP correlations where |corr| <= 0.5 and REMOVE those where |corr| > 0.5. This is what we did.

-- Final query for submission
WITH gene_correlations AS (
    SELECT a.sample_type, p.gene_symbol, 
           CORR(p.protein_abundance_log2ratio, LOG(r.fpkm_unstranded + 1)) as correlation
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` a
    ON p.sample_id = a.sample_id
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current` r
    ON a.sample_submitter_id = r.sample_barcode
    AND p.gene_symbol = r.gene_name
    WHERE a.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND r.primary_site = 'Kidney'
    AND r.project_short_name = 'CPTAC-3'
    GROUP BY a.sample_type, p.gene_symbol
),
filtered_correlations AS (
    SELECT sample_type, gene_symbol, correlation
    FROM gene_correlations
    WHERE correlation IS NOT NULL
    AND ABS(correlation) <= 0.5
)
SELECT sample_type, AVG(correlation) as avg_correlation
FROM filtered_correlations
GROUP BY sample_type

  FROM paad_clinical c

    (a + b + c + d) * POWER(a * d - b * c, 2) * 1.0 / ((a + b) * (c + d) * (a + c) * (b + d)),

SELECT

    CASE WHEN Level3 IS NOT NULL AND Level2 IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN Level3 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Level3' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN Level4 IS NOT NULL AND (Level2 IS NOT NULL OR Level3 IS NOT NULL) THEN ', ' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN Level4 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Level4' ELSE '' END

-- "What percentage of weather stations recorded valid temperature data (with no missing or invalid values) for at least 90% of the days in 2022, 
-- where the temperature, maximum, and minimum values are neither NULL nor equal to 9999.9, 
-- and the station has a valid identifier (USAF code not equal to '999999'), 
-- out of all available stations in the NOAA GSOD database?"

-- The answer should be a single percentage value. Let me produce it cleanly:
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*) / (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stn) 
            FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` 
            WHERE stn != '999999'
        ), 2
    ) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT stn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
    WHERE stn != '999999'
    GROUP BY stn
    HAVING SAFE_DIVIDE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        COUNT(*)
    ) >= 0.9

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT
    trip_id,
    duration_sec,
    start_date,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) AS year_month,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(duration_sec, 60) AS duration_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    duration_min,
    start_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year_month ORDER BY start_date ASC) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year_month ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM trips
),
first_last AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS first_trip_duration,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS last_trip_duration
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT
  fl.year_month,
  fl.first_trip_duration,
  fl.last_trip_duration,
  t.highest_trip_duration,
  t.lowest_trip_duration
FROM first_last fl
JOIN (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    MAX(duration_min) AS highest_trip_duration,
    MIN(duration_min) AS lowest_trip_duration
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY year_month
) t ON fl.year_month = t.year_month
ORDER BY fl.year_month;

  WHERE pitchSpeed > 0 AND pitcherId IS NOT NULL AND pitchSpeed <= 130
  AND (

    OR
    pitcherId IN (awayFielder1, awayFielder2, awayFielder3, awayFielder4, awayFielder5, awayFielder6, awayFielder7, awayFielder8, awayFielder9, awayFielder10, awayFielder11, awayFielder12, awayBatter1, awayBatter2, awayBatter3, awayBatter4, awayBatter5, awayBatter6, awayBatter7, awayBatter8, awayBatter9)
  )
),
max_speeds AS (
  SELECT

    pitcherFirstName,
    pitcherLastName,
    MAX(pitchSpeed) as max_pitch_speed

),
ranked AS (

    pitcherId,
    pitcherFirstName,
    pitcherLastName,
    max_pitch_speed,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pitcher_team_id ORDER BY max_pitch_speed DESC, pitcherId ASC) as rn
  FROM max_speeds
)
SELECT pitcher_team_name, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_pitch_speed
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY pitcher_team_name

-- Find the day of week with most trips from the top station in 2018
WITH top_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND start_station_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY start_station_id
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
station_trips AS (
  SELECT t.start_station_id,
         EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM t.starttime) as day_of_week,
         EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.starttime) as hour_of_day
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips` t, top_station ts
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.starttime) = 2018
    AND t.starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND t.start_station_id = ts.start_station_id
),
day_counts AS (
  SELECT day_of_week, SUM(1) as cnt
  FROM station_trips
  GROUP BY day_of_week
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
hour_counts AS (
  SELECT hour_of_day, SUM(1) as cnt
  FROM station_trips
  GROUP BY hour_of_day
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT dc.day_of_week, hc.hour_of_day
FROM day_counts dc, hour_counts hc

WITH borough_station_counts AS (

stations_with_ada_entrance AS (

SELECT

-- Final result: all stations within 20 miles with valid temp observation counts 2011-2020
WITH stations_in_radius AS (
  SELECT 
    s.usaf,
    s.wban,
    s.name,
    s.lat,
    s.lon,
    ST_Distance(
      ST_GeogPoint(s.lon, s.lat),
      ST_GeogPoint(-73.764, 41.197)
    ) as distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s
  WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
      ST_GeogPoint(s.lon, s.lat),
      ST_GeogPoint(-73.764, 41.197),
      32186.88
    )
    AND s.lat != 0.0
    AND s.lon != 0.0
)
SELECT 
  si.name,
  si.usaf,
  si.wban,
  ROUND(si.distance_meters / 1609.344, 2) as distance_miles,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.temp IS NOT NULL AND g.temp != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as valid_temp_observations
FROM stations_in_radius si
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` g
  ON si.usaf = g.stn AND si.wban = g.wban
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
GROUP BY si.name, si.usaf, si.wban, si.lat, si.lon, si.distance_meters
ORDER BY si.distance_meters

WITH sales_2022 AS (

),
sales_2023 AS (
  SELECT item_number, item_description, SUM(sale_dollars) as sales_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE date >= '2023-01-01' AND date < '2024-01-01' AND sale_dollars > 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
)
SELECT

  s22.item_description,
  ROUND(s22.sales_2022, 2) as sales_2022,

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_code,
    c.state_code_name,
    c.inventory_year,
    c.proportion_basis,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
    p.expansion_factor,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR' 
    AND c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
),
subplot_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    state_code_name,
    inventory_year,
    'subplot' as plot_type,
    expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot as plot_size
  FROM filtered
  WHERE proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0
),
macroplot_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    state_code_name,
    inventory_year,
    'macroplot' as plot_type,
    expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot as plot_size
  FROM filtered
  WHERE proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, state_code_name, avg_size
  FROM (
    SELECT plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, state_code_name, AVG(plot_size) as avg_size
    FROM subplot_calc
    GROUP BY plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, state_code_name
  )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, state_code_name, avg_size
  FROM (
    SELECT plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, state_code_name, AVG(plot_size) as avg_size
    FROM macroplot_calc
    GROUP BY plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, state_code_name
  )
)
SELECT plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, state_code_name, avg_size
FROM combined
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plot_type, inventory_year ORDER BY avg_size DESC) = 1
ORDER BY inventory_year, plot_type

WITH top5_2008 AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year = 2008
  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
year_totals AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(value) as total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  GROUP BY year
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT c.year, t.minor_category, SUM(c.value) as crime_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa` c
  JOIN top5_2008 t ON c.minor_category = t.minor_category
  GROUP BY c.year, t.minor_category
)
SELECT 
  yt.year,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc.crime_count, yt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) as pct_other_theft,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc2.crime_count, yt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) as pct_theft_from_motor_vehicle,

  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc5.crime_count, yt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) as pct_assault_with_injury
FROM year_totals yt
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc ON yt.year = cc.year AND cc.minor_category = 'Other Theft'
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc2 ON yt.year = cc2.year AND cc2.minor_category = 'Theft From Motor Vehicle'
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc3 ON yt.year = cc3.year AND cc3.minor_category = 'Possession Of Drugs'
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc4 ON yt.year = cc4.year AND cc4.minor_category = 'Burglary in a Dwelling'

-- Final answer: provider with highest combined average costs (inpatient + outpatient) using average_total_payments
WITH inpatient AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 
         AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_inpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
),
outpatient AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 
         AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_outpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
)
SELECT i.provider_id, i.provider_name, 
       ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment, 2) as avg_inpatient_payment,
       ROUND(o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) as avg_outpatient_payment,
       ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment + o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) as combined_avg_cost

SELECT 
  fullVisitorId,
  date,
  device.isMobile AS is_mobile,
  MAX(date) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId) AS max_date,
  MIN(CASE WHEN totals.transactions > 0 THEN date END) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId) AS min_txn_date
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
LIMIT 10

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews AS pageviews,
    totals.transactions AS transactions,
    CASE WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END AS classification
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
    AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
),
visitor_class_sum AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) AS total_pageviews
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
avg_pageviews AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', month) AS month,
    classification,
    AVG(total_pageviews) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor
  FROM visitor_class_sum
  GROUP BY month, classification
)
SELECT
  month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) AS avg_pageviews_purchase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) AS avg_pageviews_non_purchase
FROM avg_pageviews
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%B %Y', MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date))) AS month,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '3'), COUNTIF(h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2')) * 100, 2) AS add_to_cart_conversion_rate,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'), COUNTIF(h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2')) * 100, 2) AS purchase_conversion_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170331'
  AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type IN ('2', '3', '6')
GROUP BY FORMAT_DATE('%B %Y', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date))
ORDER BY MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date))

WITH first_visit AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
sessions_with_transactions AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, date, device.deviceCategory AS transaction_device_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
    AND totals.transactions > 0
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, date AS first_transaction_date, transaction_device_category
  FROM (
    SELECT fullVisitorId, date, transaction_device_category,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC) AS rn
    FROM sessions_with_transactions
  ) sub
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT fv.fullVisitorId
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.transaction_device_category = 'mobile'
  AND ft.first_transaction_date > fv.first_visit_date
ORDER BY fv.fullVisitorId

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_GEOGPOINT(usa_longitude, usa_latitude) as storm_center,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(usa_r34_ne, 0), COALESCE(usa_r34_se, 0), COALESCE(usa_r34_sw, 0), COALESCE(usa_r34_nw, 0)) as max_r34
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND name != 'NOT_NAMED' AND usa_wind >= 35
    AND (usa_r34_ne IS NOT NULL OR usa_r34_se IS NOT NULL OR usa_r34_sw IS NOT NULL OR usa_r34_nw IS NOT NULL)
),
us_ports AS (
  SELECT p.port_name, p.port_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_international_ports.world_port_index` p
  WHERE p.region_number = '6585' AND p.country = 'US'
)
SELECT up.port_name
FROM us_ports up
JOIN storm_points sp
  ON ST_WITHIN(up.port_geom, ST_BUFFER(sp.storm_center, sp.max_r34 * 1852))
GROUP BY up.port_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH postal_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    'postal_code' as granularity,
    SUM(count_qualified) as total_buildings,
    AVG(percent_covered) as avg_percent_covered,
    AVG(percent_qualified) as avg_percent_qualified,
    SUM(number_of_panels_total) as total_panels,
    SUM(kw_total) as total_kw,
    SUM(yearly_sunlight_kwh_total) as total_kwh,
    SUM(carbon_offset_metric_tons) as total_carbon_offset,
    SUM(existing_installs_count) as total_existing_installs,
    SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0) as adjusted_potential,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0) - SUM(existing_installs_count), 
                SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0)) as installation_gap_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sunroof_solar.solar_potential_by_postal_code`
  GROUP BY state_name
),
census_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    'census_tract' as granularity,
    SUM(count_qualified) as total_buildings,
    AVG(percent_covered) as avg_percent_covered,
    AVG(percent_qualified) as avg_percent_qualified,
    SUM(number_of_panels_total) as total_panels,
    SUM(kw_total) as total_kw,
    SUM(yearly_sunlight_kwh_total) as total_kwh,
    SUM(carbon_offset_metric_tons) as total_carbon_offset,
    SUM(existing_installs_count) as total_existing_installs,
    SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0) as adjusted_potential,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0) - SUM(existing_installs_count), 
                SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0)) as installation_gap_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sunroof_solar.solar_potential_by_censustract`
  GROUP BY state_name
)
SELECT 
  state_name,
  granularity,
  total_buildings,
  ROUND(avg_percent_covered, 2) as avg_percent_covered,
  ROUND(avg_percent_qualified, 2) as avg_percent_qualified,
  total_panels,
  ROUND(total_kw, 2) as total_kw,
  ROUND(total_kwh, 2) as total_kwh,
  ROUND(total_carbon_offset, 2) as total_carbon_offset,
  total_existing_installs,
  ROUND(adjusted_potential, 2) as adjusted_potential,
  ROUND(installation_gap_pct, 4) as installation_gap_pct
FROM postal_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  state_name,
  granularity,
  total_buildings,
  ROUND(avg_percent_covered, 2) as avg_percent_covered,
  ROUND(avg_percent_qualified, 2) as avg_percent_qualified,
  total_panels,
  ROUND(total_kw, 2) as total_kw,
  ROUND(total_kwh, 2) as total_kwh,
  ROUND(total_carbon_offset, 2) as total_carbon_offset,
  total_existing_installs,
  ROUND(adjusted_potential, 2) as adjusted_potential,
  ROUND(installation_gap_pct, 4) as installation_gap_pct
FROM census_agg
ORDER BY state_name, granularity

hours AS (

cross_grid AS (

trip_daily AS (

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    title,
    body,
    tags,
    view_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-layout(\||$)') THEN 'android-layout'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-activity(\||$)') THEN 'android-activity'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-intent(\||$)') THEN 'android-intent'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-edittext(\||$)') THEN 'android-edittext'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-fragments(\||$)') THEN 'android-fragments'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-recyclerview(\||$)') THEN 'android-recyclerview'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)listview(\||$)') THEN 'listview'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-actionbar(\||$)') THEN 'android-actionbar'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)google-maps(\||$)') THEN 'google-maps'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-asynctask(\||$)') THEN 'android-asynctask'
    END as tag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)(android-layout|android-activity|android-intent|android-edittext|android-fragments|android-recyclerview|listview|android-actionbar|google-maps|android-asynctask)(\||$)')
    AND (LOWER(title) LIKE '%how%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%how%')
    AND NOT (LOWER(title) LIKE '%fail%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%problem%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%wrong%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%fix%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%bug%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%issue%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%solve%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%trouble%'
         OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%fail%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%problem%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%wrong%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%fix%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%bug%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%issue%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%solve%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%trouble%')
),
tag_counts AS (
  SELECT tag, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY tag
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
)
SELECT f.id, f.tag, f.view_count, f.title
FROM filtered f
JOIN tag_counts tc ON f.tag = tc.tag
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.tag ORDER BY f.view_count DESC) <= 50

WITH answer_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    parent_id,
    SUM(score) AS total_score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  WHERE score IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY parent_id
),
ranked_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    a.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.parent_id ORDER BY a.score DESC) AS rank
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
),
associated_users AS (
  -- Condition 1: user owns the question
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id AS question_id, q.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Condition 2: their answer is the accepted answer
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE a.id = q.accepted_answer_id
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Condition 3: answer score > 5
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE a.score > 5
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Condition 4: answer score > 20% of total answer scores for that question AND score > 0
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON a.parent_id = q.id
  JOIN answer_stats s ON s.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE a.score > 0 
    AND a.score > 0.2 * s.total_score
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Condition 5: answer is among top 3 highest-scoring answers
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN ranked_answers a ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE a.rank <= 3
)
SELECT au.user_id, u.display_name, SUM(au.view_count) AS total_view_count
FROM associated_users au
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON u.id = au.user_id

WITH answers AS (

  WHERE a.owner_user_id = 1908967
    AND a.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    v.post_id,
    COUNTIF(v.vote_type_id = 2) as upvote_count,
    COUNTIF(v.vote_type_id = 1) as accepted_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` v
  WHERE v.vote_type_id IN (1, 2)
  GROUP BY v.post_id
),
answer_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    a.answer_id,
    a.tags,
    COALESCE(av.upvote_count, 0) as upvote_count,
    COALESCE(av.accepted_count, 0) as accepted_count,
    10 * COALESCE(av.upvote_count, 0) + 15 * COALESCE(av.accepted_count, 0) as score
  FROM answers a
  LEFT JOIN answer_votes av ON a.answer_id = av.post_id
)
SELECT 
  tag,
  SUM(score) as total_score

UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) as tag

WITH co_zip_blocks AS (

co_zip_block_stats AS (

-- Final query: census tracts in 36047 area that are in top 20 for both population % increase and absolute income increase, with >1000 residents in both years
WITH pop_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    t11.geo_id,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(t18.total_pop - t11.total_pop, t11.total_pop) * 100 AS pop_pct_increase,
    t11.total_pop AS pop_2011,
    t18.total_pop AS pop_2018,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(t18.total_pop - t11.total_pop, t11.total_pop) * 100 DESC) AS pop_rank
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t11
  INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t18
    ON t11.geo_id = t18.geo_id
  WHERE t11.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
    AND t11.total_pop > 1000
    AND t18.total_pop > 1000
),
income_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    t11.geo_id,
    t18.median_income - t11.median_income AS income_abs_increase,
    t11.median_income AS income_2011,
    t18.median_income AS income_2018,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t18.median_income - t11.median_income DESC) AS income_rank
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t11
  INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t18
    ON t11.geo_id = t18.geo_id
  WHERE t11.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
    AND t11.total_pop > 1000
    AND t18.total_pop > 1000
)
SELECT 
  p.geo_id,
  ROUND(p.pop_pct_increase, 2) AS pop_pct_increase,
  p.pop_2011,
  p.pop_2018,
  ROUND(i.income_abs_increase, 2) AS income_abs_increase,
  i.income_2011,
  i.income_2018,
  p.pop_rank,
  i.income_rank
FROM pop_ranked p
INNER JOIN income_ranked i ON p.geo_id = i.geo_id
WHERE p.pop_rank <= 20 AND i.income_rank <= 20
ORDER BY p.pop_rank

WITH monthly_usage AS (

all_months AS (

),
combined AS (
  SELECT

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN m.total_minutes_in_thousands ELSE NULL END), 0) AS customer_minutes,

  FROM all_months a

month_over_month AS (

    trip_month,

  FROM monthly_trips
),
max_increase_per_company AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    trip_month,
    increase,
    trip_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY increase DESC) AS rn
  FROM month_over_month
  WHERE increase IS NOT NULL

WITH minute_groups AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT SAFE_CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) AS trip_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL AND trip_seconds >= 60 AND trip_seconds <= 3000
),
grouped_minutes AS (
  SELECT trip_minutes, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY trip_minutes) AS quantile_group
  FROM minute_groups
),
group_ranges AS (
  SELECT quantile_group,
         MIN(trip_minutes) AS min_minutes,
         MAX(trip_minutes) AS max_minutes
  FROM grouped_minutes
  GROUP BY quantile_group
)
SELECT gr.quantile_group,
       CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(gr.min_minutes AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm to ', LPAD(CAST(gr.max_minutes AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm') AS time_range,
       COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
       ROUND(AVG(t.fare), 2) AS avg_fare
FROM group_ranges gr
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips` t
  ON SAFE_CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN gr.min_minutes AND gr.max_minutes
WHERE t.trip_seconds IS NOT NULL AND t.trip_seconds >= 60 AND t.trip_seconds <= 3000
GROUP BY gr.quantile_group, gr.min_minutes, gr.max_minutes
ORDER BY gr.quantile_group

purchase_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId, visitNumber, visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'

),
user_initial_visit AS (

  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, initial_timeOnSite

has_purchase_after AS (

  INNER JOIN purchase_sessions ps

    AND (ps.visitNumber > uiv.init_visitNum OR (ps.visitNumber = uiv.init_visitNum AND ps.visitStartTime > uiv.init_visitStart))
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uiv.initial_timeOnSite > 300 AND hpa.fullVisitorId IS NOT NULL THEN uiv.fullVisitorId END) * 100.0,

FROM user_initial_visit uiv

WITH patient_conditions AS (
  SELECT 
    c.subject.patientId,
    c.code.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].code as condition_code,
    c.code.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].display as condition_display
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.subject.patientId IS NOT NULL
),
patients_with_one_condition AS (
  SELECT 
    patientId,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT condition_code ORDER BY condition_code)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] as single_condition_code,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT condition_display ORDER BY condition_display)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] as single_condition_display,
    COUNT(DISTINCT condition_code) as num_conditions
  FROM patient_conditions
  GROUP BY patientId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT condition_code) = 1
),
living_patients AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  WHERE p.deceased.boolean IS NULL 
    OR p.deceased.boolean = FALSE
),
filtered_patients AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.patientId,
    pc.single_condition_code,
    pc.single_condition_display
  FROM patients_with_one_condition pc
  JOIN living_patients lp ON pc.patientId = lp.id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p ON pc.patientId = p.id
  WHERE (SELECT n.family FROM UNNEST(p.name) n LIMIT 1) LIKE 'A%'
),
patient_med_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.patientId,
    fp.single_condition_code,
    fp.single_condition_display,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].code) as num_active_meds
  FROM filtered_patients fp
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr

user_first_last AS (

WITH state_2015 AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year = 2015
  GROUP BY LEFT(CoC_Number, 2)
),
state_2018 AS (
  SELECT LEFT(CoC_Number, 2) as state_abbr, SUM(Unsheltered_Homeless) as total_unsheltered
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year = 2018
  GROUP BY LEFT(CoC_Number, 2)
),
state_change AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(s15.state_abbr, s18.state_abbr) as state_abbr,
    COALESCE(s15.total_unsheltered, 0) as unsheltered_2015,
    COALESCE(s18.total_unsheltered, 0) as unsheltered_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s18.total_unsheltered, 0) - COALESCE(s15.total_unsheltered, 0), s15.total_unsheltered) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM state_2015 s15
  FULL OUTER JOIN state_2018 s18 ON s15.state_abbr = s18.state_abbr
  WHERE s15.total_unsheltered > 0
),
national_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
  FROM state_change
  WHERE state_abbr IN ('AL','AK','AZ','AR','CA','CO','CT','DE','FL','GA','HI','ID','IL','IN','IA','KS','KY','LA','ME','MD','MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK','OR','PA','RI','SC','SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT sc.state_abbr, sc.pct_change, na.avg_pct_change, ABS(sc.pct_change - na.avg_pct_change) as diff_from_avg,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(sc.pct_change - na.avg_pct_change), sc.state_abbr) as rn
  FROM state_change sc, national_avg na
  WHERE sc.state_abbr IN ('AL','AK','AZ','AR','CA','CO','CT','DE','FL','GA','HI','ID','IL','IN','IA','KS','KY','LA','ME','MD','MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK','OR','PA','RI','SC','SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY')
)
SELECT state_abbr
FROM ranked

-- Final verification query
WITH sorafenib_target_uniprot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
sorafenib_target_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.target_uniprotID, pe.stable_id as pe_stable_id
  FROM sorafenib_target_uniprot st
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON st.target_uniprotID = pe.uniprot_id
),
all_pe_with_tas AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id, pathway_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77`
  WHERE evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
lowest_level_tas_pathways AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ppe.pathway_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ppe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON ppe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  WHERE p.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_pe AS (
  SELECT pathway_stable_id, pe_stable_id
  FROM all_pe_with_tas
  WHERE pathway_stable_id IN (SELECT pathway_stable_id FROM lowest_level_tas_pathways)
),
pathway_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pp.pathway_stable_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN stp.pe_stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN pp.pe_stable_id END) as a,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN stp.pe_stable_id IS NULL AND pp.pe_stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN pp.pe_stable_id END) as c
  FROM pathway_pe pp
  LEFT JOIN sorafenib_target_pe stp ON pp.pe_stable_id = stp.pe_stable_id
  GROUP BY pp.pathway_stable_id
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe_stable_id) FROM sorafenib_target_pe) as total_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT apt.pe_stable_id) FROM all_pe_with_tas apt WHERE apt.pe_stable_id NOT IN (SELECT pe_stable_id FROM sorafenib_target_pe)) as total_non_targets
),
pathway_with_chisq AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.pathway_stable_id,
    p.name as pathway_name,
    pc.a as targets_within,
    tc.total_targets - pc.a as targets_outside,
    pc.c as non_targets_within,
    tc.total_non_targets - pc.c as non_targets_outside,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      POWER((pc.a * (tc.total_non_targets - pc.c)) - ((tc.total_targets - pc.a) * pc.c), 2) * (tc.total_targets + tc.total_non_targets),
      (tc.total_targets) * (tc.total_non_targets) * (pc.a + pc.c) * ((tc.total_targets - pc.a) + (tc.total_non_targets - pc.c))
    ) as chi_squared
  FROM pathway_counts pc
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pc.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
)
SELECT pathway_stable_id, pathway_name, chi_squared, targets_within, targets_outside, non_targets_within, non_targets_outside
FROM pathway_with_chisq
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3
