WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id, a.assay_id, a.doc_id, a.molregno, a.standard_type, 
         a.standard_value, a.standard_relation, 
         SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) AS pv, a.potential_duplicate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  WHERE SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
),
mol_assay_counts AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno,
         COUNT(*) AS act_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dup_count
  FROM filtered_activities
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
  HAVING act_count < 5 AND dup_count < 2
),
qualified_activities AS (
  SELECT fa.*
  FROM filtered_activities fa
  JOIN mol_assay_counts mac ON fa.assay_id = mac.assay_id AND fa.standard_type = mac.standard_type AND fa.molregno = mac.molregno
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT fa1.activity_id AS activity_id_1, fa2.activity_id AS activity_id_2,
         fa1.assay_id, fa1.standard_type,
         fa1.molregno AS molregno_1, fa2.molregno AS molregno_2,
         fa1.standard_value AS sv1, fa2.standard_value AS sv2,
         fa1.standard_relation AS sr1, fa2.standard_relation AS sr2,
         fa1.doc_id AS doc_id_1, fa2.doc_id AS doc_id_2
  FROM qualified_activities fa1
  JOIN qualified_activities fa2 ON fa1.assay_id = fa2.assay_id 
    AND fa1.standard_type = fa2.standard_type 
    AND fa1.molregno != fa2.molregno
  WHERE fa1.activity_id < fa2.activity_id
),
mol_info AS (
  SELECT cp.molregno AS molregno, cp.heavy_atoms, cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT doc_id, journal, 
         COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970) AS year,
         SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64) AS first_page_int,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970) ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64)) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970)) AS grp_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
),
doc_pub_dates AS (
  SELECT doc_id,
         year,
         CASE WHEN grp_size = 1 THEN 1 
              ELSE SAFE_CAST(FLOOR(((rn - 1) * 1.0 / (grp_size - 1)) * 11) + 1 AS INT64) 
         END AS month,
         CASE WHEN grp_size = 1 THEN 1 
              ELSE MOD(SAFE_CAST(FLOOR(((rn - 1) * 1.0 / (grp_size - 1)) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 
         END AS day
  FROM doc_dates
),
pair_data AS (
  SELECT p.activity_id_1, p.activity_id_2,
         p.assay_id, p.standard_type,
         p.sv1, p.sv2,
         p.doc_id_1, p.doc_id_2,
         COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(mi1.heavy_atoms AS INT64), 0) AS ha1,
         COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(mi2.heavy_atoms AS INT64), 0) AS ha2,
         mi1.canonical_smiles AS smiles_1,
         mi2.canonical_smiles AS smiles_2,
         dpd1.year AS year1, dpd1.month AS month1, dpd1.day AS day1,
         dpd2.year AS year2, dpd2.month AS month2, dpd2.day AS day2
  FROM pairs p
  LEFT JOIN mol_info mi1 ON p.molregno_1 = mi1.molregno
  LEFT JOIN mol_info mi2 ON p.molregno_2 = mi2.molregno
  LEFT JOIN doc_pub_dates dpd1 ON p.doc_id_1 = dpd1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN doc_pub_dates dpd2 ON p.doc_id_2 = dpd2.doc_id
),
with_dates AS (
  SELECT *,
    CONCAT(
      CAST(COALESCE(year1, 1970) AS STRING), '-',
      LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(month1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-',
      LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(day1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0')
    ) AS pub_date_1,
    CONCAT(
      CAST(COALESCE(year2, 1970) AS STRING), '-',
      LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(month2, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-',
      LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(day2, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0')
    ) AS pub_date_2
  FROM pair_data
),
with_latest_date AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE 
      WHEN pub_date_1 >= pub_date_2 THEN pub_date_1 
      ELSE pub_date_2 
    END AS latest_pub_date
  FROM with_dates
)
SELECT 
  activity_id_1,
  activity_id_2,
  GREATEST(ha1, ha2) AS max_heavy_atoms,
  latest_pub_date,
  GREATEST(doc_id_1, doc_id_2) AS highest_doc_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(sv1 AS FLOAT64) > SAFE_CAST(sv2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'decrease'
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(sv1 AS FLOAT64) < SAFE_CAST(sv2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'increase'
    ELSE 'no-change'
  END AS change_type,
  to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(activity_id_1, smiles_1)))) AS uuid_1,
  to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(activity_id_2, smiles_2)))) AS uuid_2
FROM with_latest_date

WITH scoring_events AS (
  SELECT 
    period,
    game_clock,
    team_name,
    points_scored,
    event_description,
    elapsed_time_sec
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
    AND points_scored > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec ASC, event_description ASC) as rn
  FROM scoring_events
)
SELECT 
  r1.period,
  r1.game_clock,
  r1.team_name,
  r1.points_scored,
  r1.event_description,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r2.points_scored) FROM ranked r2 
   WHERE r2.period = r1.period AND r2.team_name = 'Wildcats' 
     AND (r2.rn < r1.rn OR (r2.rn = r1.rn AND r2.event_description <= r1.event_description))), 0) 
   + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r3.points_scored) FROM ranked r3 
   WHERE r3.period < r1.period AND r3.team_name = 'Wildcats'), 0) as wildcats_score,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r4.points_scored) FROM ranked r4 
   WHERE r4.period = r1.period AND r4.team_name = 'Fighting Irish' 
     AND (r4.rn < r1.rn OR (r4.rn = r1.rn AND r4.event_description <= r1.event_description))), 0)
   + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r5.points_scored) FROM ranked r5 
   WHERE r5.period < r1.period AND r5.team_name = 'Fighting Irish'), 0) as irish_score
FROM ranked r1
ORDER BY r1.period, r1.elapsed_time_sec ASC, r1.event_description ASC

        OR seg5 LIKE '%shop by brand%' OR seg5 LIKE '%small goods%' OR seg5 LIKE '%stationery%' 
        OR seg5 LIKE '%wearables%'
      )
    THEN 'PDP' ELSE 'other' END as page_type
  FROM classified
),
pdp_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ga_session_id FROM is_pdp WHERE page_type = 'PDP'
),
plp_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as plp_views_that_led_to_pdp
  FROM is_plp
  WHERE page_type = 'PLP'
  AND ga_session_id IN (SELECT ga_session_id FROM pdp_sessions)
),
total_plp_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_plp_views FROM is_plp WHERE page_type = 'PLP'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT plp_views_that_led_to_pdp FROM plp_count) as plp_views_that_led_to_pdp,
  (SELECT total_plp_views FROM total_plp_count) as total_plp_views,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT plp_views_that_led_to_pdp FROM plp_count), (SELECT total_plp_views FROM total_plp_count)) * 100 as percentage

-- Calculate the final percentage
WITH installers AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 
         MIN(event_timestamp) as first_open_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180930'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
uninstalls AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 
         MIN(event_timestamp) as first_remove_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'app_remove'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.user_pseudo_id IS NULL 
             THEN i.user_pseudo_id END) +
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL 
             AND u.first_remove_ts > i.first_open_ts + 604800000000 
             THEN i.user_pseudo_id END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.user_pseudo_id)
  ) * 100 as percentage_no_uninstall_within_7_days_or_never
FROM installers i
LEFT JOIN uninstalls u ON i.user_pseudo_id = u.user_pseudo_id

WITH first_qp_per_user AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) as first_quickplay_timestamp
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180915'
    AND event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
first_qp_type AS (
  SELECT 
    fpu.user_pseudo_id,
    fpu.first_quickplay_timestamp,
    e.event_name as quickplay_event_type,
    e.event_date as first_quickplay_date_str
  FROM first_qp_per_user fpu
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON fpu.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_timestamp = fpu.first_quickplay_timestamp
    AND e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    quickplay_event_type,
    first_quickplay_timestamp,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_quickplay_date_str) as first_quickplay_date
  FROM first_qp_type
  WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_quickplay_date_str) BETWEEN DATE '2018-08-01' AND DATE '2018-08-15'
),
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.quickplay_event_type,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'session_start' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) >= DATE_ADD(c.first_quickplay_date, INTERVAL 8 DAY)
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) < DATE_ADD(c.first_quickplay_date, INTERVAL 15 DAY)
  GROUP BY c.user_pseudo_id, c.quickplay_event_type
)
SELECT quickplay_event_type,
       COUNT(*) as total_users,
       SUM(retained) as retained_users,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained), COUNT(*)), 4) as retention_rate
FROM retention
GROUP BY quickplay_event_type
ORDER BY retention_rate ASC

session_pages AS (

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn,
    user_pseudo_id,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') as page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') as page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    user_pseudo_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)]), r'\+')
        AND (
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)], '+', ' ')), r'accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables')
          OR
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)], '+', ' ')), r'accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables')
        )
      THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5
        AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)]), r'\+')
        AND (
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)], '+', ' ')), r'accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables')
          OR
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)], '+', ' ')), r'accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables')
        )
      THEN 'PLP'
      ELSE page_title
    END as display_title
  FROM page_views
),
with_flag AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    user_pseudo_id,
    display_title,
    CASE WHEN display_title != COALESCE(LAG(display_title) OVER (ORDER BY rn), '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_new
  FROM classified
),
merged AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    user_pseudo_id,
    display_title
  FROM with_flag
  WHERE is_new = 1
)
SELECT 
  user_pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_title, '>>' ORDER BY rn) as navigation_flow
FROM merged
GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
